verdict.rationale: Hugging Face is an API platform, so versioning and deprecation policy are fair questions, but the evidence pack shows neither a versioned API scheme nor a documented deprecation policy. The published OpenAPI spec and the OpenAI-compatible endpoint are adjacent features, not versioning or deprecation guarantees. A community report says HF libraries break public APIs in minor releases without documenting it, which points away from such a policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
